interpretation: UNet and PINN-UNet are supervised amortized inverse maps; they are strong baselines but can smooth multimodal or discontinuous structures.
DPS/DDPM has a generative prior but repeated long-chain guidance through denoised clean estimates can be unstable for nonconvex FWI.
C2F-SVGD-FM uses pure raw-noise FlowMap proposals, multiscale blind ranking, multi-time z_t assimilation, and gated SVGD/Adam updates.
